prompt:
Create one production sprite atlas for NPC073's angry speech mouths, using the supplied exact 3×3 repeated-original-lower-half grid as the only reference image.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: native pixel-art portrait mouth atlas
Primary request: Create nine restrained angry visemes for the same NPC073 lower-face crop.
Composition: Exactly three equal columns and three equal rows. Each cell is one complete lower 64×29 crop. Whole canvas must keep 64:29 cell aspect ratio. Row-major order A B C / D E F / G H X. No labels, gutters, borders, added panels, scaling between cells, or full-face views.
Subject and identity: Preserve NPC073 nose, original muted skin colors, blue wand at left, hair, chin, neck, crop and register. Keep original pink lip color and lip scale. Anger uses firm, tense lips with restrained corner tension. Do not turn every pose into a frown or smile.
Style and palette: Crisp native pixel art, soft low-contrast brown/terracotta palette. Teeth use muted neutral gray-ivory, distinct from skin, with modest dark oral-cavity contrast. Avoid bright tooth flashes.
Exact Rhubarb pose meanings:
A: pressured closed P/B/M.
B: narrow opening, teeth nearly together, consonants/EE.
C: medium unrounded EH/AE.
D: wide AA.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER, no wider than C.
F: puckered UW/OW/W.
G: upper teeth touching lower lip, F/V.
H: tongue raised behind upper teeth for L, opening between C and D.
X: relaxed closed idle.
Constraints: Keep pose geometry true to each definition at native scale. Show teeth only where phoneme pose requires them. Keep G as upper-teeth-to-lower-lip contact, H as visible raised tongue behind upper teeth. A and X remain emotionally firm/closed, with angry tension subtle and different only as needed for pose.
Avoid: lipstick red, skin-colored teeth, tooth gaps, bright shiny white teeth, oversized mouths, black outlines, extreme downturned corners, giant skin patches, changed nose/jaw/hair/neck, blur or antialias smoothing.
